+    def test_union(self):
+        @functools.singledispatch

+
+        @f.register

+            return "typing.Union"
+
+        @f.register
+        def _(arg: int | float):
+            return "types.UnionType"
+
+        self.assertEqual(f([]), "default")
+        self.assertEqual(f(""), "typing.Union")
+        self.assertEqual(f(b""), "typing.Union")
